sloka: राम शोक अभिसम्तप्ता सा देवी वाम लोचना ।वन वास रता नित्यम् एष्यते वन चारिणी ॥५-१४-४७॥
transliteration: rāma śoka abhisamtaptā sā devī vāma locanā ।vana vāsa ratā nityam eṣyate vana cāriṇī ॥5-14-47॥

translations.english: "That lovelyeyed queen tormented with grief over separation from Rama will be coming here to stay as she always loves strolling in the forest.
